why: AT2020 needs 48V phantom power over XLR; UMC22 has a combo XLR mic input with selectable 48V phantom power.
SM58-LC is an XLR dynamic mic; UCA202 has unbalanced RCA line inputs only and no mic preamp.
Yeti Orb connects over USB Type-C only with no XLR output; Solo 4th Gen takes mics on an XLR input.
M50x is 38 ohm with a 6.3mm adapter included; 2i2 4th Gen headphone output drives 32mW into 33 ohm.
SM58S is a dynamic XLR-3M mic needing no phantom power; Solo 4th Gen has a Neutrik XLR mic input.
